data.body: a5bf (ADR 0113 fixture-mining & admission protocol): fixed the G6 blocking finding — ADR §5 rewritten from the wrong 'two-of-three majority' to the real rule (selection-time reproduction consensus = >=2 equal material_fingerprint reviews; admission-time epoch majority (epochs//2)+1), and §4 corrected to the real tier rule (blocking = all three fire signals reproduction_consensus+author_response+margin, else advisory) after verifying both against fixture_selection.py:186-269 and fixture_admission.py:348-390. Re-ran review-plan -> PASS (exit 0, signed). Claimed a5bf. Wrote docs/adr/0113-fixture-mining-and-admission-protocol.md, indexed it in docs/adr/README.md, referenced it from docs/plan-review-gate.md. All 4 ACs grep-pass; boxes ticked. make lint exit 0. Committed (Change-Id I74aae7e, rebar-ticket trailer, DCO) stacked on 1cef; pushed -> Gerrit change 2621. Stack: 2610(5169) -> 2615(1cef) -> 2621(a5bf). Gate state after conflict-rebase re-push: 2615 LLM-Review+1 AND Verified+1; 2610 LLM-Review+1, Verified re-running; 2621 both pending. Waiting out CI/LLM-review backlog before closing a5bf and submitting the stack. NOT touching the other session's shared-main work.
